reopened_reason: RS092 falsifies the owner0 endpoint-order explanation; RS093 identifies native relative-sign invariants and a minimal capacity star.

new_assertions.body: All5 RS092 endpoint gauges are pooled exact. Owner0-first and anonymous ordering have rank353; owner1-first, prefix/tie and full edge-reversal quotient rank351. The successful native repair does not require the owner0-first lexicographic endpoint convention.

The rank351 full endpoint-reversal map and rank351 RS090 common-triangle map have different111-dimensional kernels; their sum has dimension113. Their finest common linear quotient therefore has rank349. Equal ranks do not imply equal information.

For5 exact plus/minus count channels, reversal fixes totals T and negates all signed imbalances N. T, absolute N and complete pairwise sign correlations reconstruct the common reversal orbit, including zero coordinates. This is a native algebraic invariant, not an empirical catalog definition.

In the16-subset RS093 grid, exactly the8 subsets containing CAPACITY_DEPTH pass; the unique minimal family is its4-edge capacity star, rank350. All subsets without it have18 contradictions and preserve only the matched-dependency draw character. The full reversal control has rank351.

The capacity star recovers the full reversal orbit when N_C is nonzero. When N_C is zero it retains only unordered plus/minus depth counts. This structurally defined forgetting is sufficient on the corpus, but does not imply zero scalar contribution on balanced pairs or prove all4 star edges individually necessary.
The globally defined reversal quotient avoids reliance on an observed-domain class catalog, but retains owner channels. It neither contradicts nor removes the earlier owner-swap closure obstruction.
Minimality of the capacity star among4 edge families does not establish minimality among its4 individual edges. The next full edge-subset grid must be frozen before replay.
